title: Kde je stanica?
topic: Zuzana is in Bratislava for the first time, asks the way to the station and catches a bus to her train in time

sentences.sk: Zuzana nie je z Bratislavy a mesto nepozná.
sentences.en: Zuzana is not from Bratislava and does not know the town.

sentences.sk: Teraz stojí na námestí a pozerá do mapy.
sentences.en: Now she is standing on the square and looking at a map.

sentences.sk: Jej vlak ide o hodinu.
sentences.en: Her train leaves in an hour.

sentences.sk: Ale kde je stanica? Na mape ju nevidí.
sentences.en: But where is the station? She can't see it on the map.

sentences.sk: Prepáčte, kde je stanica?
sentences.en: Excuse me, where is the station?

sentences.sk: Hlavná stanica? To je ďaleko.
sentences.en: The main station? That's far.

sentences.sk: Môžem ísť pešo?
sentences.en: Can I walk?

sentences.sk: Môžete, ale pešo je to pol hodiny.
sentences.en: You can, but on foot it's half an hour.

sentences.sk: To je veľa. Môj vlak ide o hodinu.
sentences.en: That's a lot. My train leaves in an hour.

sentences.sk: Tak choďte autobusom. Zastávka je blízko.
sentences.en: Then go by bus. The stop is close.

sentences.sk: A kde je zastávka?
sentences.en: And where is the stop?

sentences.sk: Choďte rovno a potom vpravo. Zastávka je pri kostole.
sentences.en: Go straight on and then right. The stop is by the church.

sentences.sk: Ten autobus ide rovno na stanicu.
sentences.en: That bus goes straight to the station.

sentences.sk: Ďakujem! A kde kúpim lístok?
sentences.en: Thank you! And where do I buy a ticket?

sentences.sk: Lístok kúpite na zastávke.
sentences.en: You buy a ticket at the stop.

sentences.sk: Zuzana ide rovno a potom vpravo.
sentences.en: Zuzana goes straight on and then right.

sentences.sk: Pri kostole je zastávka, ale autobus tam nie je.
sentences.en: By the church there is the stop, but the bus isn't there.

sentences.sk: Na zastávke čaká malý chlapec.
sentences.en: A little boy is waiting at the stop.

sentences.sk: Ahoj, kedy ide autobus na stanicu?
sentences.en: Hi, when does the bus to the station leave?

sentences.sk: Teraz. Pozri, už ide!
sentences.en: Now. Look, here it comes!

sentences.sk: Zuzana rýchlo kúpi lístok a nastúpi do autobusu.
sentences.en: Zuzana quickly buys a ticket and gets on the bus.

sentences.sk: Autobus ide cez most a potom cez mesto.
sentences.en: The bus goes over the bridge and then through the town.

sentences.sk: O dvadsať minút je Zuzana na stanici.
sentences.en: Twenty minutes later Zuzana is at the station.

sentences.sk: Jej vlak tam už stojí.
sentences.en: Her train is already there.

sentences.sk: Super! Ešte mám čas na kávu.
sentences.en: Great! I still have time for a coffee.

questions.q: Prečo nejde Zuzana na stanicu pešo?

recap: Zuzana cannot find the station on her map. A man tells her it is far and sends her to the bus stop by the church, and she reaches her train with time left for a coffee.

choďte.gloss: go! (to two or more people, or politely)
